correctness.rationale: For F3(x,y), y³−y=x+1/(x³−x), the four poles x=0,±1,∞ are rational simple and totally ramified; Artin–Schreier genus formula yields g=6. Translation x→x+1 permutes finite poles and adds one to f; absolute trace shift is n mod3, so for every n with 3∤n exactly one zero-trace point in each three-orbit and N_n=3^n+1. Independent direct finite-field extensions n=1..6 by explicit irreducible polynomials and fiber-count enumeration returned [4,10,76,82,244,670]. Newton identities and genus6 functional equation force L=1+16T³+118T⁶+432T⁹+729T¹², and direct convolution confirms square [(1−T+3T²)(1+T−2T²+3T³+9T⁴)]². E:v²=u³+u²+2 has #E(F3)=3, trace1; quartic inverse Frobenius factor irreducible, ordinary and a genuine Weil factor, giving Jac(X)~(E×A)² over F3 and Jac(F3)=1296. Full infinite n identity rests on orbit proof and Weil functional equation, not a finite extrapolation.
